appDescription: Listen to English news and practise speaking about the same story with Drive English.

function.name: DRIVE_ENGLISH_PLAYBACK
function.description: Control news listening or explicitly choose the pending original, a different ready article, or keep waiting. pending_original, pending_alternative and pending_wait use only command, without mode or articleTitle, and each requires separately verified project schema approval and actual current pending input. They do not reformat the current article or apply global settings.

command.description: The explicit listening action requested by the user.

articleTitle.description: The exact title of the article requested by the user, when specified.

function.name: DRIVE_ENGLISH_ARTICLE_QUESTION
function.description: Ask a question about the current or explicitly named news article, using the stored source as evidence.

questionText.description: The question asked by the user. Preserve the language used.

articleTitle.description: The exact title of the article requested by the user, when specified.

function.name: DRIVE_ENGLISH_PRACTICE
function.description: Start or continue English speaking practice, review the original answer assessment, explicitly select a learning band for subsequent selections, or read/apply/keep/dismiss the current reference recommendation. New learning preference commands require separate actual project approval and verified current input; recommendation actions require exact actual reviewed delivery and explicit confirmation.

command.description: The exact explicit practice or learning preference action. A preference action uses only command, never utteranceText or articleTitle. It does not change the pinned article, current lesson, other settings drafts, or today listening-only choice.

utteranceText.description: The answer supplied by the user. This parameter alone does not verify original speech language or literal fidelity.

articleTitle.description: The exact title of the article requested by the user, when specified.
